subject: general
question: What is the total number of India’s neighbouring countries?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Nine__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A total of 9 countries shares borders with India.
 
• Out of these, 7 countries share land borders while 2 countries share sea
